correctness.rationale: At a terminal world, modal terms are constants (box=1, diamond=0). On either open comparison stratum, the order of 0,x,1-x,1 is constant. Minimum selects a fixed operand on that stratum; Gödel implication selects 1 or its consequent by the same fixed order; involution permutes the four choices. Induction thus proves the normal form for arbitrary terms, including arbitrary nesting. In each open stratum its extrema occur at one of the two retained extremal degrees, and the three occupied singletons need only one witness each. This preserves each root modal subterm for the same chosen subset, and preserving the root atom then preserves all root formulas. Checked the five indicators algebraically, including the midpoint equality test and exclusion of 0 and 1 from the open strata. The four masked diamonds uniquely expose the two extremes of each open stratum on the seven designated degrees, and three further diamonds expose the singletons. Spread compares the conditional maximum to the conditional minimum; on the empty stratum it compares 0 to 1 and is false, and with one distinct degree it compares a degree to itself and is false. In the displayed order the first k requirements therefore need k leaves, are jointly attainable with k, and their negated conjunction is valid at all leaves because the first diamond is false there. To transfer countervaluations, duplication leaves extrema unchanged; pruning and then duplication transfers any large-star root countervaluation to exactly seven leaves. A terminal countervaluation transfers independently of root and other leaf values. These checks establish both sharpness statements. The inspected check.py supplies recorded finite, exact-grid corroboration only; it was not executed or needed for the continuum induction.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Finite countermodel or tableau results do not by themselves give a common subset of a fixed model preserving every formula value. A witnessed extremum for each formula does not impose a fixed uniform number of witnesses for all formulas.

originality.rationale: A materially close same-day indexed result gives exactly three leaves and a three-stage hierarchy without involution. It neither models the open upper and lower strata separately nor proves the degree-preserving bound and six separating formulas in the expanded language. The primary literature supplies the target semantics and finite-model/tableau methods; no equivalent seven-leaf statement was found in the decisive inspected material. The finding is distinct as an extension in expressivity, not as a new semantics or a novel general finite-model method.
residual_risks: The earlier tableaux paper was checked by relevant passages, not exhaustively. Ranked search and the bounded literature reading do not exclude an unindexed equivalent. Same-day publication does not resolve precedence.

value.rationale: This is an optimal formula-independent compression bound and a complete branching-validity hierarchy, with explicit witnesses so each degree of branching can be tested. It measures exactly what the stronger unary signature can distinguish beyond the three-leaf reduct. Its utility is specific to one-variable finite crisp stars with terminal successors, not a decision bound for arbitrary Gödel models.
